request.type: boolean (optional, defaults to false when omitted)

response.type: stop_reason: "refusal"; stop_details: {type: "refusal", category: "cyber" | "bio" | null, explanation: string | null} | null

response.type: {type: "error", error: {type: enum, message: string}, request_id: string | null}
response.semantics: Top-level HTTP error envelope (400, 401, 403, 404, 413, 429, 500, 529 overloaded_error).

stream.semantics: Mid-stream SSE error frame emitted after HTTP 200 stream establishment (e.g. overloaded_error). Documented in Anthropic streaming guide; absent from the RawMessageStreamEvent union in anthropic_openapi_sdk-v1.3.0.yaml.

stream.type: {stop_reason: "refusal", stop_details: RefusalStopDetails | null, stop_sequence: string | null}
stream.semantics: Streamed terminal refusal carrier delivered on message_delta.

request.type: {role: "tool", content: string | ChatCompletionRequestToolMessageContentPart[], tool_call_id: string}
request.semantics: No structured error carrier on tool-result messages in Chat Completions. Only role, content, and tool_call_id exist. Translators must either drop is_error or serialize an error wrapper into content (e.g. AI SDK 4.0.89 JSON-stringifies {"error": ...} into content).

request.type: string | null (optional)
request.semantics: Echoed assistant refusal message on multi-turn history replay.

response.semantics: Structured refusal text generated by the model when refusing a request (typically accompanied by content: null and finish_reason: "stop").
Indicates output was omitted due to a flag from OpenAI content filters.

response.type: {error: {message: string, type: string, param: string | null, code: string | null}}

Terminal stream chunk finish_reason when content filter stops generation.

request.type: "in_progress" | "completed" | "incomplete" | null (optional)

response.type: status: "failed"; error: {code: ResponseErrorCode, message: string} | null

Structured truncation / content-filter / steering carrier when status == "incomplete".
Typed refusal content part inside an OutputMessage item.

Streamed refusal content part events.

response.semantics: Candidate-level abnormal/error/safety termination reason and optional human-readable detail message.
Prompt-level block carrier when input is rejected by safety/policy filters (candidates may be omitted or empty).

response.semantics: HTTP 400 INVALID_ARGUMENT returned live on native generateContent for missing/corrupted thoughtSignature, invalid tool names, or empty contents; on Gemini's OpenAI-compat endpoint (/v1beta/openai/chat/completions), HTTP 400 is wrapped in a 1-element JSON array [{"error": ...}].

request.semantics: Stateless/ZDR reasoning continuity token. Populated when requested via include: ["reasoning.encrypted_content"] and replayed in subsequent turns' input array.

request.semantics: Call pairing token between function_call and function_call_output items (distinct from item id fc_...).

stream.type: {type: "response.output_item.done", output_index: integer, item: OutputItem, sequence_number: integer}

request.type: string (byte / base64)
request.semantics: Opaque encrypted thought signature. Probed LIVE on gemini-3.8-flash and gemini-3.5-flash-lite: (1) MANDATORY on Gemini 3 when replaying model functionCall turns (missing -> HTTP 400 INVALID_ARGUMENT); (2) on parallel functionCalls in the same model turn, ONLY the first functionCall part carries/validates thoughtSignature; (3) fabricated base64 -> HTTP 400 "Corrupted thought signature."; (4) documented bypass sentinel base64("skip_thought_signature_validator") == "c2tpcF90aG91Z2h0X3NpZ25hdHVyZV92YWxpZGF0b3I=" (and context_engineering_is_the_way_to_go) -> HTTP 200.

request.type: string (optional in Discovery schema; FunctionCall.name + FunctionResponse.name are required)

response.semantics: Emitted live on the first functionCall part of a model turn (and on text/final parts when thinking is enabled).
Unique function call ID populated live by Gemini 3.5-flash-lite in responses.

stream.semantics: Probed LIVE on streamGenerateContent?alt=sse: attached to the first functionCall part on tool turns, or on a trailing part with empty text {"text": "", "thoughtSignature": "..."} on text turns.

response.semantics: Exact 7-value StopReason enum in anthropic_openapi_sdk-v1.3.0.yaml. Accompanied by stop_sequence (string | null) when stop_reason == "stop_sequence" and stop_details (RefusalStopDetails | null) when stop_reason == "refusal".

stream.semantics: stop_reason is null in message_start and delivered in message_delta.delta.stop_reason prior to message_stop.

response.semantics: 5-value finish_reason enum per choice (function_call is deprecated in favor of tool_calls). Note: refusals use finish_reason == "stop" with message.refusal != null.

stream.semantics: null on intermediate delta chunks; set to one of the 5 enum values on the final chunk for each choice index (before the choices:[] usage chunk and data: [DONE]).

request.type: string enum
request.semantics: Per-item status enum on input/output items.

response.semantics: Two-level response termination state. Unlike Chat Completions, tool-call turns terminate with status == "completed" (there is no tool_calls status; tool calls are detected by inspecting output[type == "function_call"]).

stream.semantics: Terminal stream event carries the finalized Response object with status and incomplete_details/error.

response.type: string enum (22 values in v1beta Discovery)
response.semantics: Candidate termination reason. Crucially, Gemini has NO TOOL_USE / tool_calls finishReason: normal functionCall turns return finishReason == "STOP" (probed LIVE on gemini-3.8-flash and gemini-3.5-flash-lite; MAX_TOKENS also probed LIVE).

response.type: string enum (6 values in v1beta Discovery)
response.semantics: Prompt-level block reason when input is blocked prior to candidate generation.

stream.field_path: candidates[].finishReason (on terminal SSE chunk; may also appear on intermediate chunks in some models)
stream.semantics: Probed LIVE on streamGenerateContent?alt=sse (STOP and MAX_TOKENS observed on terminal chunk).

fields.input_tokens: integer (required; NON-cached input tokens only — additive convention: total_input = input_tokens + cache_creation_input_tokens + cache_read_input_tokens)
fields.server_tool_use: ServerToolUsage | null ({web_search_requests: integer, web_fetch_requests: integer}, L46449)

response.semantics: Anthropic Usage is ADDITIVE for cached tokens (input_tokens excludes cache_creation_input_tokens and cache_read_input_tokens), unlike OpenAI/Gemini where prompt/input tokens are inclusive of cached tokens.

stream.semantics: Split across two SSE events: initial input/cache counts in message_start.message.usage; cumulative final counts (specifically output_tokens and optional updated input/cache/server_tool_use counts) in message_delta.usage.

request.semantics: Must be set to true on streaming requests for the server to emit the final usage chunk.

fields.completion_tokens_details: {reasoning_tokens?: integer, audio_tokens?: integer, accepted_prediction_tokens?: integer, rejected_prediction_tokens?: integer, text_tokens?: integer}

response.semantics: Inclusive accounting matching Chat Completions semantics but renamed to input_tokens / output_tokens.

stream.semantics: usage is null on response.created / response.in_progress and populated on the terminal response.completed / response.incomplete / response.failed event.

response.semantics: Probed LIVE (including 90/90 pairs in compat_channel_ej): totalTokenCount == promptTokenCount + candidatesTokenCount + thoughtsTokenCount. Unlike OpenAI where completion_tokens/output_tokens includes reasoning_tokens, Gemini's candidatesTokenCount EXCLUDES thoughtsTokenCount.

stream.semantics: Probed LIVE on streamGenerateContent?alt=sse: usageMetadata is emitted on each chunk, with final cumulative promptTokenCount, candidatesTokenCount, thoughtsTokenCount, and totalTokenCount on the terminal chunk.

request.type: Tool: {name: ^[a-zA-Z0-9_-]{1,128}$, description?: string, input_schema: InputSchema, strict?: boolean, cache_control?: ...}; ToolChoice: {type: "auto" | "any" | "tool" | "none", name?: string (for "tool"), disable_parallel_tool_use?: boolean (on auto/any/tool)}

request.type: thinking: {type: "enabled", budget_tokens: integer >= 1024 (< max_tokens), display?: "summarized" | "omitted"} | {type: "disabled"} | {type: "adaptive", display?: "summarized" | "omitted"}; output_config: {effort?: "low" | "medium" | "high" | "xhigh" | "max", format?: {type: "json_schema", schema: object}}

request.type: system: string | RequestTextBlock[]; metadata: {user_id?: string | null}; service_tier: "auto" | "standard_only"; cache_control: CacheControlEphemeral | null; container: string | null; inference_geo: string | null

request.type: tools: ChatCompletionTool[] (FunctionObject.name max 64 chars ^[a-zA-Z0-9_-]+$, strict?: boolean | null); tool_choice: "none" | "auto" | "required" | ChatCompletionNamedToolChoice | ChatCompletionAllowedToolsChoice; parallel_tool_calls: boolean (default true)

request.semantics: Probed LIVE: thinkingConfig (thinkingBudget / includeThoughts) and responseSchema/responseJsonSchema (probe_schema_leniency.json verified live that responseSchema rejects additionalProperties:false with HTTP 400 while responseJsonSchema accepts standard JSON Schema keywords).
